note: EP6 valid, IN, bulk, 512 B, quad buffer

note: AUTOOUT: USB bulk OUT packets committed straight to the slave FIFO

name: EP6FIFOCFG=0x08
note: AUTOIN: slave FIFO data committed straight to USB bulk IN
